newsitem.title: USA: Metromedia buys stake in Chinese venture.
newsitem.headline: Metromedia buys stake in Chinese venture.

text.p: Metromedia International Group Inc said on Monday its subsidiary, Metromedia Asia Corp, acquired a majority stake in Asian American Telecommunications Corp through a stock swap.
After the acquisition, Metromedia will own about 56.7 percent of Asian American Telecom. Existing shareholders and AAT owners will own the remainder of the shares.
"We are now well positioned to capitalize on the enormous opportunities available in China," said Stuart Subotnick, president and chief executive of Metromedia International.

AAT, through a joint venture, has a contract with China Unicom, a provider of telephony services, to offer telecommunications services with an initial capacity of 50,000 lines in Sichuan Province in China.
AAT also has a contract to construct a GSM, Global System for Mobile Communications, network with a capacity of 50,000 subscribers, within the city of Ningbo.
The company said Max Bobbit, the president and chief executive of AAT, will hold the same titles at Metromedia Asia.
